notes: IMPORTANT EREV EXCLUSION: Deepal sells S07 and L07 globally in both pure-BEV and EREV (range-extender) form. In Australia only the S07 is sold, and only as a pure BEV - no EREV S07 has launched here. The L07 sedan has NOT launched in Australia at all (official L07 AU page returns 404 as of this research; AU press describes it only as teased/under consideration since Oct 2024, no confirmed date or pricing) - excluded entirely, not listed as announced due to lack of any confirmed AU launch commitment. Deepal E07 'Multitruck' is a BEV; its EREV version exists only in China and is unconfirmed for AU - excluded. E07 is a 5-seat SUV-ute crossover, included here as a passenger vehicle per Deepal/AU press classification (not a dual-cab ute). S07 19-inch-wheel variant is sold out (runout); only the 20-inch variant remains orderable. Deepal AU has moved to drive-away-only promotional pricing for S07 as of Sept 2026; the E07 prices below are stated as MSRP/MLP before on-road costs per WhichCar/CarExpert. No official usable-vs-gross battery split is published for either model.
